name: long-term-bond-yields
title: Long Term Government Bond Yields (10y)
description: Monthly average US 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED series DGS10), sourced from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Values are expressed as a percentage. Coverage starts April 1953.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
sources.title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity (DGS10)

resources.name: us-treasury-10y-yields
resources.description: Monthly average US 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield from April 1953 onwards. Each row is one calendar month; the Yield value is the mean of all daily observations published by FRED for that month, rounded to two decimal places.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: Month of the observation in YYYY-MM format (e.g. 2025-02).

fields.name: Yield
fields.description: Monthly average 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield, expressed as a percentage (e.g. 4.26 means 4.26%).
